bulldoze.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

geomancy.name: Geomancy

high_horsepower.name: High Horsepower

pollen_puff.effect: Damages opponents, but heals allies for 50% of their max HP.

lunge.name: Lunge

brutal_swing.name: Brutal Swing

coaching.name: Coaching
